correctness.rationale: Centered simplex-edge normalization and Johnson incidence eigenvalues give the exact Gram-sector formulas. Degree 0–2 algebra and exact symbolic degree 3–5 factorizations establish low ranks. A self-contained pure-Python rational-root certificate exhausts all integer dimensions n>=5 for 54 sector polynomial numerators in degrees 3..20. A separate analytic conic/Wronskian argument rules out any nonzero row annihilator for all degrees k>=21. An independent SymPy Gegenbauer computation agreed with the verifier on 80 exact dimension-degree triples. These computations are not used to infer the infinite step.

value.rationale: A canonical infinite family of simplex-edge midpoint two-distance sets admits a complete exact-degree spherical harmonic sampling classification. The n=16 fifth-index cancellation is a motivated non-antipodal harmonic-design anomaly, the three Gram eigenvalues and every rank deficiency are explicitly determined, and full surjectivity is proved for every n>=5 and k>=6. These are natural interpolation and design invariants, not arbitrary numerical slices or small routine improvements.
